heading.title: A place to unwind, celebrate and reconnect.

body_paragraphs: CelestialEve is a peaceful destination created for unforgettable stays, meaningful celebrations and moments shared with the people who matter most. Surrounded by nature and designed for comfort, it's a place where you can truly slow down and feel at home.

Whether you're planning a family getaway, a special celebration, a weekend escape, or a corporate gathering, our thoughtfully designed spaces, cozy accommodations and welcoming atmosphere provide the perfect setting for every occasion.

services_section.intro_text: From peaceful weekend escapes and family vacations to weddings, celebrations and corporate events, CelestialEve offers versatile spaces designed to bring people together. Enjoy comfortable stays, beautiful surroundings and warm hospitality that make every visit memorable.
